source: standalone The Bibites launch at -screen-width 1920 -screen-height 1080 -window-mode windowed, window hidden via Win32; BepInEx bridge + parity plugin; /d/ui_overlay routes
notes: Native 1920 overlays are crisp: title/settings full overlays have tens of thousands of unique colors and down/up residual ~0.11; the in-world toolbar overlay is transparent with 347 unique colors.

Menu overlays are still opaque full-screen because the game's Title Screen/BackGround canvas composition covers the UI; /d/ui_overlay_ui_only excluding BackGround+Title Screen returned an opaque 310-color frame, so transparent UI-only menu references need a different canvas/background isolation step.
World overlay is a native transparent UI-only overlay suitable for alpha-IoU/MAE A/B.
menu_isolation_blocker: Title Screen/BackGround exclusion leaves opaque menu; UI/Popuholder/screenBlocker + fullscreen suppression yields alpha0 menu overlay.

in_world_refs.note: Native 1920 transparent UI-only in-world refs; toolbar/placer/dynamic/lineage are partial alpha, Stats/Genes/Biology/Brain/Information/Settings panels include their opaque full-panel backdrop (alpha 1) as the game renders them.

in_world_capture.method: standalone hidden 1920 window, bridge load rust_seed_600 paused; /d/ui_overlay

native_runtime_atlas.node_rects: each active node has screen_bbox + world_corners (1920 px space)

menu_background.note: UI hidden (UI/Title Screen/screenBlocker off, BackGround on); Time.timeScale=0 + VideoPlayer.Pause(); title and settings share the same frame.
